thread:
maria: Heads-up — we're trying to finalize how request IDs / spans get propagated so the new runtime dashboards can join traces, logs, and metrics. Need cross-team decision on header names and sampling policy. @paul @tara

paul: +1. We get a lot of mismatched ids in dashboards now. What's the minimal surface we need? request_id, trace_id, span_id?

maria: Minimal: request_id (correlation across front->runtime->worker), trace_id, span_id for sampled traces. Also want a header that indicates sampling decision so dashboards can filter sampled vs unsampled.

tara: For headers I'd prefer namespaced prefixes so they don't collide with external clients. Proposal: `X-RW-Req-Id`, `X-RW-Trace-Id`, `X-RW-Span-Id`, `X-RW-Trace-Decision` (values `1`/`0`). Thoughts?

kevin: That looks fine. Two questions: 1) who sets the request id (edge/gateway vs client)? 2) if gate sets trace_id/span_id, how do we ensure services don't overwrite?

maria: 1) Accept client request id if provided, otherwise gateway generates `X-RW-Req-Id` (uuid4). 2) Tracing libs will only set trace headers if absent, otherwise honor existing. We'll add an immutable flag in our sdk middleware to avoid accidental overwrite.

josh: About sampling: runtime needs a stable sampling decision so dashboards can backfill metrics. Suggest sampling decision done at gateway and propagated via `X-RW-Trace-Decision`. Sampling policy: 1% default, 100% for error responses (>=500) and for any latency > 2s. Also allow route-level overrides (eg. onboarding flows 5%).

paul: Implementation note: our existing exporter pipeline uses `trace.sampler` at collector. If we do gateway decision, we need to tag spans with `rw.sampling.decision` to avoid double-sampling. Also add `rw.sampling.source=gateway` tag.

maria: Good call. Dashboard team: we'll emit metric tags: `request_id`, `trace_id` (empty string if unsampled), `sampled=true/false`. Metrics to add: `runtime.request.latency_ms`, `runtime.request.count`, `runtime.request.error_count`, all with `request_id` and `route` label.

tara: On the console side we need a lightweight join key — `request_id` is fine. For trace link buttons, we need `trace_id` for sampled traces. If unsampled, show "Trace not collected" but still link logs filtered by request_id.

paul: Can we standardize the format for `trace_id` (hex 16/32 bytes)? Let's pick W3C traceparent compatible, so upstream vendors can correlate. So `X-RW-Trace-Id` should be the W3C trace-id hex (32 chars).

kevin: Agree. Also ensure `X-RW-Span-Id` uses 16 char hex per W3C. We'll add middleware in our Go and Python runtimes. I'll own the Go lib.

josh: One more operational thing — sampling decision changes over time. We should record the sampling rate used per minute and expose `runtime.tracing.sampling_rate` metric so alerting can detect config drift.

maria: Ops: infra-bot, can you create a short RFC in docs and add the header names, sampling decision logic, and SDK middleware responsibilities? We'll need rollout plan: 1) gateway sets headers; 2) runtime libs adopt and emit metrics; 3) dashboards updated to join by request_id and show trace button.

infra-bot: RFC ticket created: RW-TRACE-2026 (link: https://redwood.internal/rw/TRACE-2026). Template includes header names, W3C compatibility note, sampling policy, and SDK changes.

paul: For rollout, recommend a 2-week canary on dedicated and hosted-staging, then 4-week gradual ramp for hosted. Add a fallback: if `X-RW-Trace-Decision` missing, runtime will decide locally but mark `rw.sampling.source=local` so dashboards know.

tara: UX: in console, add a toggle to show only sampled traces or all requests with their request_id. Also add per-route sampling override UI that writes to a central config (feature flag).

kevin: I'll open PRs for Go/Python middleware. Will add unit tests to ensure headers are preserved when present and set when missing.

josh: I'll wire the collector to tag spans with `rw.sampling.source` and `rw.sampling.decision`. Also will add `runtime.tracing.sampling_rate` metric exposed to Prom.

maria: Thanks. Action items: kevin PR by EOD Friday, josh collector change next week, tara console mock by Wed. Paul will own rollout plan doc. Any objections? :eyes:

paul: No objections. :thumbsup:

tara: No objections. :thumbsup:

kevin: None.

josh: None.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for infra-bot/RW-TRACE-2026-canary on hosted-staging at 2026-07-06T03:00:00Z.

maria: Great — leaving this thread open for follow-ups. If you make breaking changes to header names, ping here first.
